tasks.title: Answers for the congress entry form

steps.request: The Ratingsdesk SDK, the package ratingsdesk-sdk, is already in the project and already set up with the credentials in RATINGSDESK_CLIENT_ID and RATINGSDESK_SECRET; the entry form already checks players through it with enterPlayer(federationId, section) on the app that createApp() returns. When Ratingsdesk answers 404 with error unknown_player, the entry form must get a 404, with the body { error: 'No player with this federation id.' }, so it can ask the player to check the number. Every other refusal stays a 422 as today.

In the first hour of registration Ratingsdesk answers 429 with an x-ratelimit-reset header (the seconds until we may ask again). Then enterPlayer(federationId, section) must answer a 503 with the header Retry-After set to those seconds (20 when Ratingsdesk sends none), and the body { error: 'Registration is busy, please try again shortly.' }.

A section takes at most 64 players. enterPlayer(federationId, section) for a section that already has 64 entries answers 422 with the body { error: 'This section is full.' }, and Ratingsdesk is not asked.
